thesis: The speakers argue that Silicon Valley and the US defense sector, which were historically integrated from the 1950s through the 1990s, have drifted apart over the last 15 to 20 years due to growing hostility and a disconnect from the national mission. They contend that this separation is a national security problem that requires a new category of investment focused on American dynamism to rebuild the industrial base and integrate technology with the physical world.
